assay: bulk RNA-seq (SMART-Seq v4 + NexteraXT, SE75, NextSeq 500) of FACS-sorted bone-marrow LSK cells
sample_inclusion: 3 mice per group, 9 LSK libraries, all deposited
primary_estimand: Effect of 6 weeks of voluntary wheel running on the LSK (HSPC) transcriptome: Ex vs Sed
planned_contrasts: Ex vs Sed (S2.3.p3, Fig. 3o-r; Supplementary Table 2, count not stated in text)
ExSed vs Sed (S2.3.p3, Fig. 3o; persistence after wheel withdrawal)
paper_pooled_contrast_not_reproduced: All Ex (Ex + ExSed pooled) vs Sed (Fig. 3o, GSEA only)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one library per mouse, independent animals
paper_method: edgeR on tximport gene-level counts (model details not stated); GSEA on edgeR fold-change ranking (MSigDB Reactome, 1000 gene-set permutations); clusterProfiler GO/Reactome ORA on genes >= 2-fold down in Ex vs Sed

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.13.p2 (no DEG cutoff); Fig. 3p,q legend uses >=2-fold down for ORA input only

paper_results: Reactome Cell Cycle downregulated in Ex (rank 2/410, FDR=0.004) and ExSed (rank 49/410, FDR=0.01); immune activation GO terms enriched in down genes; OXPHOS gene sets in Fig. 3r
